title: Efficient first-order predictor-corrector multiple objective optimization for fair misinformation detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational efficiency of an optimization algorithm (Gauss-Newton approximation in a predictor-corrector framework) applied to multi-objective problems. While it uses 'fairness' as an objective, it treats it as a numerical constraint/metric in the context of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves.
